dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open case H = K3 for Conjecture 1.4
dossier_meta.statement_text: It remains open whether $H = K_3$ (the triangle) satisfies Conjecture 1.4.
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper's main result establishes Conjecture 1.4 for all almost-bipartite graphs $H$; almost-bipartite graphs are triangle-free, so $K_3$ is the simplest graph not covered. This gap is noted both in the abstract and in the body of the paper.
